basis: Dyskeratosis congenita is defined by marrow failure, nail/skin abnormalities and oral leukoplakia; common additional organ damage is unestablished for this subtype.
Personality disorder without intrinsic damage to an organ axis.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by calvarial lesions, bone fragility and spinal/metaphyseal abnormalities.
Isolated familial cardiomyopathy with ventricular dysfunction, hypertrophy and myocardial fibrosis.
Inherited retinal degeneration; neurological ancestry does not establish extraocular nerve or brain disease.
Generalized skeletal fibrous dysplasia with characteristic hypophosphatemia; the discordant myelofibrosis parent alone does not establish marrow damage.
Progressive skeletal muscle dystrophy. Definition specifies rare cardiac and respiratory involvement; isolated 1/1 reports do not establish population frequency.
Placental primary tumor lies outside the axes; possible metastases do not establish common damage to another organ.
Ectopic endometrial tissue directly occupies a cutaneous scar.
Umbrella disorder of liver, bile ducts and gallbladder, all covered by the hepatic axis.
Cardiac, skin/hair and neurodevelopmental abnormalities define CFC. Ocular ptosis occurs in 13/20; associated skeletal abnormalities omitted under the four-axis cap.
Spondyloepiphyseal skeletal dysplasia; cataract reported in 1/1 annotated patient, supporting ocular involvement with limited frequency evidence.
Retinal degeneration and epilepsy are the two defining disease components.
Nipple carcinoma is classified as a breast primary, which has no axis.
Congenital ureteral dilatation; ureters belong to the renal axis even without obstruction or reflux.
Defined by platelet dense-granule deficiency and oculocutaneous albinism with reduced vision; no established common pulmonary or intestinal disease in HPS11.
Tumor confined to the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
EBV-associated cutaneous T-cell lymphoma directly affects skin and lymphoid blood cells; lymphoma also requires the immune mechanism axis.
Ectatic gastric mucosal vessels define the lesion. Associated liver, renal and connective-tissue diseases are separate conditions.
Complete IL6ST deficiency causes syndromic combined immunodeficiency with bent-bone skeletal dysplasia; additional common intrinsic organ damage is unestablished.
Retinal degeneration with night blindness, visual-field constriction and severely impaired retinal electrophysiology.
Malignant vascular endothelial tumor arising in the liver; both hepatic location and vascular origin are defining.
Manganese transport disorders cause direct neurotoxicity with dystonia in most patients across both listed subtypes; liver disease and polycythemia are subtype-specific.
Bone dysplasia and brain malformations define disease. Pulmonary hypoplasia occurs in 4/7; cleft palate in 80-99% and gingival fibromatosis in 30-79%. Hearing/urinary defects are minority findings.
Acquired, self-limited erythroid marrow aplasia causes anemia and reticulocytopenia; an immune or infectious cause is not established.
